clips.title: The story
paras: The Captured Scarlet Zealot is a crusader prisoner held captive in the basement of Gallows' End Tavern in Brill. Watched over by Forsaken apothecaries and townsfolk, he serves as a living test subject for the Royal Apothecary Society's developing concoctions.

Confined beneath Gallows' End Tavern, this member of the Scarlet Crusade embodies the unyielding fanaticism of his order. Even in chains, surrounded by the undead he views as an abomination, he offers no remorse, calling on the Light to protect him from the foul and unholy creatures around him. For the Forsaken, capturing a living zealot is not an act of mercy; it provides valuable human test material to evaluate the lethality of experimental plagues and toxins under development by Apothecary Johaan.
